Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Source: target_dictionary, assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join: target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid, assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293289', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_relation = '=', activities.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC. Limit: 1000.
